Class TrainingRun

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.maven.jdkaotcache.TrainingRun
@Internal public final class TrainingRun extends Object
The JDK AOT cache training run of an application: the mode, and what ends the run. It is resolved from micronaut.docker.jdkAotCache.trainingMode, the training paths and what the application's Micronaut version can do.

Without a configured mode, the run is a LOAD run if the Micronaut version has that mode, because it creates no bean and so needs none of the services the beans use, which an image build does not have. Otherwise, it starts the application, as every Micronaut version can.

Since:
5.1.0
Author:
Álvaro Sánchez-Mariscal

      Parameters:
      configured - the configured micronaut.docker.jdkAotCache.trainingMode, or null if it is not set

      the training run
      Throws:

      public boolean usesSwitch()
